name: goo-cloud
description: goo cloud: sync and sharing server for goo (Fastify/Prisma API + Svelte dashboard). Convenience scripts for the whole repo.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix dashboard ci && npm --prefix e2e ci && npm --prefix e2e exec -- playwright install chromium
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix dashboard run typecheck && npm --prefix e2e run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.build: npm --prefix dashboard run build && npm --prefix server run build
